description: Complete an agentic signup with a Stripe Shared Payment Token, or with an spt_test_demo token (letters and digits only, for example spt_test_demostage) when AGENTIC_ALLOW_TEST_CHECKOUT=1. Creates the VoiceFlip account and voice agent, and returns the API key, agent id, and embed snippet. The same payload can be polled later via vf_get_signup_status.
name: vf_complete_signup
